read_first: home establishment, force pool, mercenary pool, civil population, or other source owner only when recruitment/replacement provenance matters
write_order: validate ownership/authority and exact source population claim
deduct or transfer conserved people from the source owner before organization
inherit source capability/body/age/aptitude/experience/qualification profile without rerolling or generic replacement
apply split/merge/refit/training/casualty transaction to the authoritative unit state
rebuild unit index and any derived battle cache
invariants: One unit is one troop type.
One durable standard loadout per unit.
Partial durable differences require a split first.
Aggregate unit math remains the large-battle representation; never expand ordinary troops into thousands of people.
A materialized aggregate unit is the single mutable owner of its ordinary personnel current capability, condition, population profile, experience and qualification state.
Ordinary aggregate personnel require conserved source claims whose counts equal live unit personnel at formation; recruitment never invents bodies or a profile.

Requested recruitment strata are real source distinctions. Hunters, farmers, veterans, craftsmen, mercenaries, state soldiers and other populations may differ only when their authoritative source owners/profiles differ; an unavailable requested stratum fails closed rather than borrowing another profile.
Named commanders and exceptional persistent individuals remain separate people and are never averaged into ordinary unit capability.
